newsitem.title: GERMANY: German April vehicle output +15 pct, cars +14 pct.
newsitem.headline: German April vehicle output +15 pct, cars +14 pct.

text.p: German motor vehicle production rose 15 percent to 489,400 units in April compared with the year-earlier month, the VDA Automobile Industry Association said on Thursday.
In the four months January through April, output rose one percent year-on-year to 1.73 million units, the VDA said in a statement.
Car production rose 14 percent in April to 456,800 and was up one percent at 1.62 million units in the January through April period, the VDA said.
Domestic orders for cars rose 31 percent in April compared with April 1996 while foreign orders rose nine percent.
The VDA said the order increases were probably due to manufacturers' announcements of future price increases. Domestic orders for trucks for the month were up 16 percent year-on-year.
New car registrations in April totalled an estimated 350,000 units, up four percent year-on-year.
